Your offer letter has been created at **`offer-letter-senior-software-engineer.md`**.

## What's Included

The letter follows the standard offer letter structure from the employment contract templates and is customized for a Senior Software Engineer role:

- **Position Details** — Full-time, exempt role reporting to Engineering leadership
- **Role Summary** — Software-specific responsibilities (code reviews, mentorship, architecture, system reliability, technical design docs)
- **Compensation** — Base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and equity grant with standard 4-year vesting / 1-year cliff
- **Benefits** — Health/dental/vision, 401(k) match, PTO, parental leave, professional development stipend
- **Contingencies** — Background check, work authorization, and execution of confidentiality/IP assignment agreements
- **At-Will Language** — Required in most U.S. jurisdictions
- **Acceptance Block** — Signature section with deadline

## Before Sending, Customize These Placeholders

- **`[COMPANY NAME]` / `[Company Letterhead]`** — Company legal name and branding
- **`[Candidate Name]`** and contact details
- **`[AMOUNT]`** — Salary figure
- **`[DATE]`, `[START DATE]`, `[DEADLINE DATE]`**
- **`[primary languages]`** — e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go (match your actual stack)
- **`[X]%` bonus, `[X] shares`, PTO days, and 401(k) match amounts** — match your real policies
- **`[Office Location / Remote / Hybrid]`** — set the work arrangement

## ⚠️ Important Legal Notes

> These templates are for informational purposes only and do not constitute legal advice. Please:
> - **Consult qualified legal counsel** before issuing — employment law varies significantly by jurisdiction (California, New York, and international locations all have different requirements).
> - **Verify bonus and equity language** — "discretionary" bonus language and equity grant terms should be confirmed by counsel.
> - **Be careful with non-compete clauses** — if applicable, enforceability varies by state and they should be reviewed by an attorney before adding.

Would you like me to also create a full **Employment Agreement**, an **NDA**, or an **IP Assignment Agreement** to accompany this offer letter?
